lines.zh: 我的蹄子踩在下界岩上，石头都裂了。
lines.en: My hoof lands on netherrack and the stone splits.

lines.zh: 我迈开大步，肩膀撞碎低垂的岩块。
lines.en: I stride wide and my shoulder smashes low rock.

lines.zh: 我一手拎着爪子，一手垂着。
lines.en: One claw raised, one hanging.

lines.zh: 我走路时，身上的火苗往后飘。
lines.en: As I walk, the flames on me trail back.

lines.zh: 我不绕路，什么挡着就撞开。
lines.en: I take no detours; whatever blocks me gets smashed.
I walk along the lava river.

lines.zh: 每一步都踩出一个浅坑。
lines.en: Every step leaves a shallow pit.

lines.zh: 我朝那座废墟走，那里有活物。
lines.en: I head for that ruin, where things live.

lines.zh: 我低吼着前行，声音在胸腔里滚。
lines.en: I growl as I go, the sound rolling in my chest.
I turn sideways between two rock walls.

lines.zh: 火光把我的影子投得很长。
lines.en: Firelight throws my shadow long.

lines.zh: 走了一阵，我抬头看了看上面的岩顶。
lines.en: After a while I glance up at the ceiling.
I stand and fire moves beneath my hide.
The grinding of my teeth is loud.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，热气把我包住。
lines.en: I hold still and the heat wraps around me.

lines.zh: 我盯着岩浆池，看了很久。
lines.en: I stare at the lava pool a long while.

lines.zh: 我把手指一根根活动了一下。
lines.en: I flex my fingers one by one.

lines.zh: 我低下头，嗅脚下的地面。
lines.en: I lower my head and sniff the ground.
The smell of sulfur comforts me.
I wait for someone to come and die.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸喷出一点火星。
lines.en: Sparks come out with my breath.
Lava bubbles at my feet.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，眼里的火很亮。
lines.en: I look down, fire bright in my eyes.
Look back — the door is gone.

lines.zh: 我闻了闻你，是血肉的味道。
lines.en: I sniff you: flesh and blood.
I square my body to you.
You are so small; why come here?

lines.zh: 我抬手擦了擦嘴边的火。
lines.en: I wipe the fire from my lips.
I watch you a while and do not move.
If you mean to fight, be quick about it.

lines.zh: 我的指甲在岩壁上刮了一下。
lines.en: My claw scrapes the rock wall once.

lines.zh: 这地方已经很久没人来了。
lines.en: No one has come here in a long time.
My roar shakes the ash loose.

lines.zh: 这一下在我皮上留了道口子。
lines.en: That leaves a line on my hide.
Fire curls out of the wound.
It hurts, but my horns still hold.
That had some strength in it.
I sway once and find my feet.
Pain only makes me want to fight.
I close my fists again.
Blood drips on stone and steams.
I will return that.
I do not touch that kind of food.
You hold it up and I do not even look.
Will that even burn?

lines.zh: 我伸手碰了一下，它就没了。
lines.en: I touch it and it is gone.
Keep it for your own use.
This thing can't even scorch me.
What I want to eat is something else.
I snort and blow it over.
That would not even fill a tooth gap.
I have little interest.

lines.zh: 你撞在我腿上，自己弹开了。
lines.en: You hit my leg and bounce off.
I do not shift a hair.
Was this hide made for you to hit?
I turn slightly and you slide past.
My shoulder knocks you back.
This close, you will burn.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，火从鼻子里出来。
lines.en: I look down with fire from my nostrils.
You are right to back away.
I lift a hoof and shift my stance.
Do not run into me again.
The nether does not deal in such things.
We don't speak of such things in Hell.
I turn my head aside with a growl.
Two barons only fight.
I want no company.
I stand with my back to it.

lines.zh: 这点火，比什么同伴都暖。
lines.en: This fire is warmer than any company.
I walk toward the lava.
It follows still, and I roar.
I walk far off.

lines.zh: 我抓起一块烧红的石头。
lines.en: I pick up a stone glowing red.
Too brittle — it crumbles in my grip.
Lighter than a flake of ash.
I throw it into the lava.

lines.zh: 我把它塞进腰间的铁环。
lines.en: I jam it into the iron ring at my waist.
It catches fire in my hand.
Useless; I stamp it to bits.

lines.zh: 这上面有别的恶魔的味道。
lines.en: This smells of another demon.

lines.zh: 我举起来看了一眼，丢掉。
lines.en: I lift it, glance, and drop it.
This bone still has some use.
One lift of my head and there you are.
I crack the ground and come for you.
Only you dare stand in this place.
I growl and the walls tremble.
I drop my shoulder to charge.
I smell the heat of you.

lines.zh: 我一步跨出去，地面裂了。
lines.en: I take a step and the ground cracks.
Stand here and do not think of leaving.
My breathing has sunk low.
You stand across my path.

lines.zh: 那东西在动，我把爪子张开。
lines.en: That thing moves, and I spread my claws.

lines.zh: 我把重心往前压，随时能扑。
lines.en: I shift my weight forward, ready to pounce.
It is not tall; it can be fought.
I shift half a step to its side.
I keep walking without pause.
Run, and my hooves follow.
I press in inch by inch.
Fire climbs up my horns.
My stride is long; you cannot circle out.
I watch your legs.
Back up more and you are against the wall.
I raise a hand and fire gathers in it.
It is panting already.
This punch is already coming.

lines.zh: 我一步步过去，脚跟砸着地。
lines.en: I go step by step, heels striking the ground.

lines.zh: 它想借岩柱绕开，我先拦住。
lines.en: It tries to slip around a pillar; I block first.
Fire in my hand burns brighter.
Other noises I ignore entirely.
It backs to the side, and there is no way there.
I can hear it breathing hard.

lines.zh: 我一拳砸下去，地陷了一块。
lines.en: My fist falls and the ground caves in.
A flat swing knocks it over.
My hoof comes down and the stone splits.
I grab it and slam it into the wall.
My hand burns as I bring it down.
It guards high and I come low.
I drive it far back.
The second punch lands heavier.
I pant with fire in my teeth.
It flees and I lift a hoof to follow.

lines.zh: 我把拳头从石头里拔出来。
lines.en: I pull my fist from the stone.
Done, I stand with my chest burning.

lines.zh: 我一爪扫过去，划开一道。
lines.en: My claw sweeps and opens a gash.

lines.zh: 火跟着爪子一起压下去。
lines.en: Fire drives down with my claw.

lines.zh: 我把它顶在岩壁上，不松。
lines.en: I hold it against the wall and do not let go.
It cuts me once and I do not give ground.

lines.zh: 我从岩浆里站起来，浑身是火。
lines.en: I rise from the lava, all fire.

lines.zh: 熔岩顺着我的胳膊淌下。
lines.en: Lava runs down my arms.
I land and the stone glows.
This nether, I know it well.

lines.zh: 我吼了一声，回声撞在墙上。
lines.en: I roar and the echo strikes the walls.
I shake the lava off.
My hoofprints leave scorch marks.

lines.zh: 远处有脚步声，我听到了。
lines.en: Steps sound far off and I hear them.
I turn my head that way.

lines.zh: 这地方安静得没有活物。
lines.en: This place is quiet with nothing living.
I raise a hand and the fire grows.
I rise out of the ash.
Fire feeds me and only makes me hotter.
I land too hard and my leg bones creak.

lines.zh: 水浇上来，大片白气腾起。
lines.en: Water hits me and a cloud of steam rises.
The blast slams me into the wall.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进肩膀，我拔了出来。
lines.en: Something lodges in my shoulder and I pull it out.

lines.zh: 术式缠上我，我的火暗了一下。
lines.en: An art binds me and my fire dims.

lines.zh: 太久没吞火，我的力气在退。
lines.en: Too long without swallowing fire and my strength goes.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我倒退了两步。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and I stagger two steps.

lines.zh: 脚下没有石头，我一路坠下去。
lines.en: No stone below and I fall away.
